Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded from the English Wikipedia infobox that Namie Amuro’s birthplace was “Okinawa, Japan,” likely based on a partial/incorrect read of the infobox without fully verifying or scrolling. Subsequent WebSurfer views showed the correct, more precise entry “Naha, Okinawa, Japan.” By not cross-checking or confirming the full infobox (and despite other signals pointing to Naha), the Planner propagated an incomplete/incorrect birthplace.
